sql: with pm as (select market_ticker, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, case when assumed_price between 93 and 95 then 'a5-7' else 'b8-10' end as band, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 90 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-11' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY') group by 1,2,3), lf as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and status='filled' and side='no' and action='buy'), lo as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and side='no' and action='buy') select series, band, case when lo.market_ticker is null then '1 never' when lf.market_ticker is not null then '3 filled' else '2 tried-unfilled' end as live, count(*) as mkts, sum(case when c<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers, round(avg(c)::numeric,2) as paper_c from pm left join lo using (market_ticker) left join lf using (market_ticker) group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
